control_design: confirmation-trigger-matched from the FULL scanned universe; per-threshold hard negatives = confirmed movers below that tier's % and outside that tier's surge windows.
method: lift = P(factor|surger)/P(factor|threshold-matched-fizzler); pure-numpy; 90% CI via 1000-sample bootstrap; verdicts gated on support.
